focus: Electrical energy systems, communications, information technology and automation
overview: Electrical Engineering covers the generation and use of electrical energy. The degree prepares students to design, operate and manage communications, information technology, electric power and automation technologies. The first two years strengthen mathematics and physical-science foundations before later study in areas including electronics, power engineering, electromagnetic engineering and mathematical methods.
career_opportunities: Antennas Engineering;Computer Engineer;Control and Automation Engineer;High Voltage Engineer;Machines and Drives Engineer;Power Engineer;Power Systems Manager;Telecommunications Engineer

focus: Software engineering, telecommunications and computer networking
overview: Information Engineering focuses on planning, designing and managing complex software systems, with emphasis on software engineering, telecommunications and computer networking. Students share the Electrical Engineering foundation in the first two years and choose the Information Engineering branch from third year. The final year includes complementary project-based courses and elective specialisation.
career_opportunities: Computer Engineer;Information Engineer;Software Developer;Software Engineer;Software Project Manager;Software Systems Architect;Network Engineer;Telecommunications Engineer;Information Technology Consultant
